data.name: Malihaah
data.gender_notes: Malihaah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Malihaah is derived from the Arabic word ‘malaha’, which means ‘to be tender, delicate, and gentle’. The name holds a spiritual significance, reminding us to be compassionate and kind towards others. The name Malihaah carries the meaning “Graceful, Tender, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Malihaah usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, tender, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies grace and compassion.
data.etymology: Malihaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Tender, Delicate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Malihaah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: مليحة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مليحة مشتق من الجمال والخُلُق الحسن، ورد في القرآن الكريم في صفات النساء الصالحات، يعني المرأة التي تتصف بالجمال الداخلي والخارجي، وتتميز بالخلق الحسن والطباع الجيدة

in_urdu.name: ملیحہ
in_urdu.meaning: خوبصورت اور اچھے اخلاق کی مالک
in_urdu.long_meaning: ملیحہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت اور اچھے اخلاق کی مالک، یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے، اور اس کا ذکر قرآن کریم میں صالحہ نساء کی صفات میں کیا گیا ہے

in_hindi.name: मलीहा
in_hindi.meaning: सुंदर और अच्छे चरित्र की मालिक
in_hindi.long_meaning: मलीहा नाम का अर्थ है सुंदर और अच्छे चरित्र की मालिक, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है, और इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में सलीहा महिलाओं की विशेषताओं में किया गया है

in_pashto.name: مليحه
in_pashto.meaning: ښايسته او د ښو اخلاقو مالکه

in_english.name: Malihaah
